name: Fresh Texas Austin
old_description: From our vibrant headquarter facility in San Antonio to our state-of-the-art automated facilities in Austin and Dallas, Fresh Texas is your premier source for consistently fresh, safe and on-time produce delivery. Experience the Fresh Texas difference!
about:
Fresh Texas operates from a headquarter facility in San Antonio with additional automated facilities in Austin and Dallas, Texas. The company traces its roots through over 45 years of fresh produce processing experience, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been publicly shared.

The business provides custom recipe and product development, high-speed high-volume production, and climate-controlled storage and transportation for fresh produce. Its facilities are SQF Excellent certified and handle organic and USDA-certified products. The company describes its operations as agile manufacturing with flexibility for complex specifications, but does not publish facility square footage, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Fresh Texas serves food manufacturers, retailers, and foodservice operators seeking ready-to-eat snacks, meal kits, and other fresh produce-based products. The company highlights its work with organics and USDA-certified options, and emphasizes long-term customer partnerships in the fresh produce and meal development sectors.

The company positions its SQF Excellent certification, temperature-controlled logistics, and over four decades of processing expertise as key differentiators. It states that its focus on quality, innovation, and dedicated service drives its ability to deliver consistently fresh, safe, and on-time produce solutions.
